title: Ozone Layer Depletion
topicTitle: Ozone layer depletion: causes, effects and control measures
notes: **Cause:** chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) release chlorine atoms in the stratosphere by UV photolysis: $CCl_3F + h\nu \rightarrow CCl_2F + Cl$. One Cl atom can destroy up to 100,000 ozone molecules by catalytic chain reaction.
**Catalytic cycle:** $Cl + O_3 \rightarrow ClO + O_2$, then $ClO + O \rightarrow Cl + O_2$. Net: $O_3 + O \rightarrow 2O_2$. Chlorine is regenerated and repeats.
**Effects:** increased UV-B reaches Earth's surface, causing skin cancer, cataracts, immune suppression, reduced crop yields (especially soybeans and wheat), and damage to marine phytoplankton.
**Montreal Protocol (1987):** phased out CFCs and other ozone-depleting substances. It is the most successful international environmental treaty.
**Recovery:** the ozone hole over Antarctica is slowly healing. Full recovery is expected by mid-21st century if controls are maintained.
